preconditions.description: The input contains exactly 1 header line, M edge lines, and Q query lines.
N, M, and Q are within the specified positive integer bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u < v <= N for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct planets u and v within the range [1, N], with u < v.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a < b <= N for a, b in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query specifies two distinct planets a and b within the range [1, N], with a < b.
The graph formed by N planets and M edges is connected.
The graph satisfies the condition that every simple cycle induces a complete subgraph (i.e., the graph is chordal).

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly Q lines, one for each query.

postconditions.expression: all(int(output_lines[i]) == shortest_path_distance(N, edges, queries[i][0], queries[i][1]) for i in range(Q))
postconditions.description: For each query i, the i-th output line contains the minimal number of edges (shortest path distance) between the two specified planets in the given graph.
